coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell: the cell's own rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink at 400 dpi). Picture pages: measured on the picture's own pixels and converted through the page's drawing matrix.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and rectangles (geom.json in work-g1); every text page with a mark looked at at 100 dpi; the 33 picture pages looked at as a contact sheet (presentation slides, nothing to complete); overlays drawn and looked at.

signing.kind: A private offering memorandum with an accredited investor questionnaire (Exhibit A, signed by the investor) and a subscription agreement (Exhibit B) countersigned by the company above a one-row subscriber table; the business presentation (pages 45-77) is slides only.
